messages.content_text:
may 5 Notes:


This section here is happening during london and before I finish my full journal, but I just wanted to get down this trade that I am forward testing. Price is in a little bit of an accumulation phase on the 1 minute, but we got a sweep of liquidity and a 1min rb forming and we trade back into it towards relative equal highs. This is a 1min trade so it may be considered a “micro model” but the reason I wouldn’t take it is because its on the 1min and We are in htf premium and medium tf premium, and the only time frame where we tapped discount is the 1min. This trade would work really well if it was a 5min or 15m trade maybe, or had better context. (Screenshot 1)
,
I then took a breakeven trade during the am session and it was unfortunate because soon after price went to my tp and would have been a winning trade.
,
Market took all time highs in pre market and when market opened we rallied higher up until 10:00 where we got a retracement and pushed higher and created a new range with 10:00 in the discount. price traded back into it and made a 5min rb off which I entered off of. Price was looking really stong after I entered, but then I got stopped at beakeven before price went and hit my tp. I think this was a strong trade and what could have made it better was entering off of 10:00 instead of the top of the rb because I would have gotten a little bit better risk wouldn’t get stopped at be. It is just one of those trading inconsistencies you have to deal with because maybe I would have missed my entry if I put my limit at 10:00 and not the rb. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,

Session: NY am
HT Bias: Bigtime bullish, we push ATH's, ES lags behind but traded into an 1H gap and didn't really show any signs of wanting to go lower. I wanted to see a 10am expansion

LT Bias: 10am had new so I had to wait for that, it was not really a big big candle so I didn't see it as a news candle. We manipulated down of open, but didn't show any strong close, just some choppy pa, so I decided to wait. Price tapped 10am and flipped very agressive so there was a lot of volatility. After that we made a good push above 10am open and I tried a aggressive entry with a 5 point stop, basically limiting 10am open, but it got edged. (would have smacked TP). Now we have a very strong close and potential re-entry if we come back down and tap discount. HOWEVER, i felt a foggy brain feeling from getting edged on the previous limit. I know this is kind of a weak mentality, but I decided to notice it and act on it. So I logged out on my broken and paper traded.

Entry Confluences (minimum 3): We made a 5m rb that tapped into discount, it also aligned perfectly with  the key open and tapped an orderblock. On paper it entered of the rb, in theory the ce would have been better on mnq. A 1m et could also have worked perfectly with OTE. The target would have been ATH. 

Entry Time: 10:51 (kinda late but still in session)

SL: 8.25

RR: 7.33

Confidence: Not the highest thats why I was on paper

Mental State during trade: Neutral (paper)

Mental state after trade/session: Kind of a weird feeling that I should remain my confidence (especially after watching Domme taking the same trade), but all we good, I journaled and I learned.

Result: Paper win

Lesson: Be confident, execute withing your session, stay focused the whole session, don't slack of torwards the end and don't leave early on the session. (unless you lose ofc)

Did I follow my rules: Yes because I did not break them, but I need a stronger mind. I can do this. Day 3 complete  (edited)

messages.content_text:
Day 1 - 05/05/26 (15m RB Short) (Loss)


Price was rallying bullish from 18:00, accumulation followed from 00:00 until around 02:30 when price continued its bullish trend
,


04:15am price was accumulating below a 15m RB I had marked (swept a previous internal high, tapped into ATH 15m wick CE and contained engineered liquidity that was followed by yesterdays strong selloff around 10:50am after it was set in)
,


At 4:45am price formed a volatile wick engineering liquidity into the same RB still below CE, I was confident in seeing a decent bearish reaction from this level. I set a LMT at the 15m RB CE targeting a full TP at the range low with my stop above the wick for 9 points. I wanted to see this area met as it was also the entry into an unmitigated hourly gap resting between 0.5 and 0.62 of the current hourly range 
,


After my SL almost being hit and sitting through 40 mins of chop I was feeling less confident in my position. I trailed my SL 50% after the 1m OB price was chopping at for 10 mins was disrespected and displaced through, from here price just rallied back up and stopped me out.
,

A big thing I failed to realise was that after almost being stopped out of my position at the start, this had actually created Equal Highs below the ATH wick CE, if i realised this I likely would have trailed all the way to BE, because Equal highs within an RB is a really strong DOL and we were currently trading in relatively close proximity to it. Just need to have a bit more awarness of what the overall structure is saying in future,
